title: qu says /kw/
parentNote: Today is qu, and the odd thing about it is that it is two letters making two sounds — k and w, squashed together into kw. Queen is k-w-ee-n. The q never turns up on its own in English, so we teach the pair and leave it at that; if your child asks what q says by itself, the honest answer is that it always brings a u with it. The slip to expect is the w going missing, so quick comes out as kick and quack as cack. Say the pair slowly yourself — k, w, kw — and then let them run it together. Watch for the lips: they should round up into a little circle straight after the k. Squid and squish are in here at the end because s-qu is a real mouthful and worth practising.

activities.mouthCue: The back of your tongue taps the roof of your mouth, and your lips round up into a little circle right after it.
activities.prompt: Two letters, and they never go anywhere on their own. Together they say kw.
The other two are the sounds hiding inside the new one. Find the one that says both at once.
All three start with the same sound in your throat. Only one of them keeps going.
Three sounds. The new one is at the front, and it does not hang about.
An s in front of the new sound. Say the s first and then let the kw come.
The long one. Four sounds and only two of them are one letter each.
All three start with the new sound, so listen to the middle and the end.
The same ending on all three. Everything you need is in the first sound.
This one is hard. Two of them have the new sound in and one of them just has a k.

activities.text: Meg said, "Be quick!" and we did squish in at the back with Dad.
Do you want to see the squid, or do you want to see the big green crab?
The queen did sit up on a red quilt and did eat a bun.
A duck did quack at me, and then it did quack at Dad, and then it did quit.

activities.title: The queen and the duck
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: Meg did want to be a queen, so she did stick a red crown on.
She said, "I am the queen. You must do it quick!" and she did sit up on the big seat.
I said, "Do you want a drink?" and the queen said yes.
But then a duck did march in, quack quack quack, and it did stop at the seat.
It did grab the red crown and it did run out to the pond.
Meg did yell, "Stop that duck!" and we did run out at top speed.
The duck did jump in the pond with the crown on its back.
Meg said, "It is not a duck. It is a robber!" and she did stamp in the mud.
Then the duck did swim back and did drop the crown at her feet.
It did quack at Meg. Meg did grin at it.
Meg said, "You can be the queen at sun up," and the duck did quack and quack.
